title: Mara and the Wolf
author: Coral Pemberton
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
